Equal Treatment Bench Book – July 2024 (May 2025 update) 149
Communicating with speakers of English as a second or third language

66. This section concerns people who are using English as a second or third learned language.

67. According to the 2021 Census, 91.1% (52.6 million) of people in the UK had English or
Welsh as their main language; 4.1 million people living in England and Wales had a main
language other than English or Welsh. The most common main language in the UK other
than English or Welsh was Polish (612,000), followed by Romanian (472,000), Punjabi
(291,000)420 and Urdu (270,000).421
